title: Work tracker settings
description: Operator settings of the work module (docs/module-wiring.md#settings). Secrets are never settings (they come from the module's Secret).

trust_proxy.description: Use the right-most X-Forwarded-For entry (set by Traefik) as the client address for rate limiting. Enable only behind a proxy that appends the client address; never when the service is directly reachable.

x-can.risk: client addresses are taken from a request header

rate_limit_per_minute.description: Requests per API token per minute; 0 disables.

auth_failures_per_minute.description: Failed authentications per client address per minute before it is throttled; 0 disables.

x-can.risk: more password guessing is let through

retention_days.description: Delete issues resolved longer ago than this; 0 keeps everything.

x-can.risk: the audit trail is deleted sooner

webhook_url.description: Where signed work.* events are POSTed. Needs CAN_WORK_WEBHOOK_SECRET.

x-can.not_applied: an installed module's events go to can-core, and no webhook secret is provisioned
